author: SC Paul
text_post: I once had sex with a friend and we stayed friends... I blamed in the booz to be honest. We went to a party to meet one of our mutual friend. Afterwards, we went just the two of us to a bar but it wasn't hot. We left and started driving... nothing very interesting to do. She had had two beers and three drinks and I had pretty much drunk the same amount. She invited me to see her new decorated place and finish up a whiskey bottle she had. I had some cool CDs that we played in her place. We danced and drunk and drunk. We sat on the sofa and she started hugging me like we do all the time but this time she started kissing me on the neck.... that led to us having sex. I didn't spend the night. The day after, we met. She works in a nearby building from where I do. We immediately started laughing hard about it and I said "I think that that was a lil too much whiskey!!". Anyway, I framed it as something "We shouldn't have done at all!" But I was okey about it. Just something that "happened", none of us planned it or anything. We still hangout. I think we were able to keep the friendship because I gave it a lil space, I kept talking to her on facebook for two weeks without meeting. And then made plans with her AND friends... we worked our way through it and never told anyone. In your case, I think she means business. But one thing I would be sure to do is : Talk about the sleeping arrangements. And say something like : "Where will you sleep? I don't know if there is a couch in there". If you go directly and sleep together, I don't think you can call it "an accident" afterwards. This is very sensitive ground and if anything happens by accident (it should be an accident anyway), I would advice you to LAUGH IT OFF. Between us, I would say "pretend it happened to you before with another female friend" and that it's something that CAN occur between people who are open about sex and Free Minded. Good luck Paul S.
